pages.text: The workstation where every $(l:trinkets/trinkets)trinket$(/l) and every Neural Chip program is made. Trinkets and programs can be made $(l)only here$(). It needs no power.

The table is a $(l)2x2$() multiblock standing upright.$(br)$(li)Place the Trinket Table.$(br)$(li)Place a $(l:basics/cyber_frame)Cyber Frame Block$(/l) on its $(l)right$() (seen from the front).$(br)$(li)Place a Cyber Frame $(l)above the table$(), and one $(l)above that frame$().
pages.title: Building it

pages.text: The table opens up, and its two robotic arms are ready to work.

It works like a $(l)crafting table$(), but shapeless:$(br)$(li)Put $(l)one item in each slot$() of its 3x3 grid, in any order.$(br)$(li)Take what it makes. Its arms go to work for a moment.$(br)$(li)Ingredients needed twice take two slots.

An upgraded Energy Sphere $(l)keeps the charge$() of the sphere you put in.
Put a Neural Chip and the programs you want to add in the grid together, and nothing else. The chip comes out with them installed. See $(l:trinkets/neural_chip)Neural Chip$(/l).
